provenance: Fresh isolated profile; normal zero-record first balloon. Real pointer holds and releases produce a near-limit success, an actual burst and an immediate retry success. Model, visible DOM and native audio were read only. No save fixtures, state/model writes, direct model.update, clock changes or replay manipulation.

videoAlignment.method: Native 25fps source frames: primary hold button changes gold to pink when pressed and pink to gold when a result is finalized. Exact transition frames cross-checked against full video images; no video or game timing is modified.

nativeRecordingOriginCheck.method: First native PCM sample above .001 compared with accepted select wall-clock event relative to recorder start.
nativeRecordingOriginCheck.note: MediaRecorder was created before the native context had advanced; this constant first-attack calibration aligns the raw master samples without changing their speed or pitch. Within one 25fps source frame.
